component.name: MQtlin
component.summary: Modern, high-performance MQTT Explorer & Broker Client

description.p: MQtlin is a comprehensive, modern MQTT exploration and debugging client designed for IoT developers, home automation enthusiasts, and backend engineers.

ul.li: Comprehensive payload inspector (Formatted JSON, Raw Text, Hex Dump)
Side-by-side and structural payload diff viewer
Live numeric charting with auto-scaling time-series axes
Retained message management and recursive branch purge
Saved broker connection profiles and multi-window workspace
Full support for MQTT 3.1.1 and MQTT 5.0 over TCP, TLS, and WebSockets

description.p: Beta 1 release of MQtlin featuring real-time hierarchical topic exploration, multi-format payload inspection, diff viewer, live sensor charting, and multi-profile connection management.
